mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(0) FROM checkin_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(checkin_time) = #{today}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(room_count), 0) FROM booking_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(planned_checkin_time) = #{today}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_rooms), 0) FROM room_type_inventory WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND stay_date = #{today}

SELECT CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.booker_name AS bookerName, o.room_count AS roomCount, o.room_type_name_snapshot AS roomTypeName, DATE_FORMAT(o.planned_checkin_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS plannedCheckinTime FROM booking_order o WHERE o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(o.planned_checkin_time) = #{today} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM room_type rt LEFT JOIN room_type_inventory i ON i.room_type_id=rt.id AND i.stay_date=#{today} AND i.is_deleted=0 WHERE rt.is_deleted=0 AND i.id IS NULL
